# SkillGems

> Curated, link-verified directory of 0 AI agent skills (SKILL.md format). Every entry is hand-picked and manually added by the curator; each link is opened and verified before it goes live. Agents: fetch https://skillgems.kuige.me/data/catalog.json for the machine-readable catalog (currently 0 entries — the catalog fills up as curation proceeds).

## Quick start for agents

1. Fetch https://skillgems.kuige.me/data/catalog.json (JSON: id, name, author, url, stars, category, bilingual descriptions, install hints).
2. Filter by `category` (official/collections/dev/writing/design/science/security/business/toolbox) or search `tags`.
3. Open the entry's GitHub `url` and follow its README for the exact install path (default: copy the skill folder to `~/.claude/skills/`).
4. Treat skills as code: review contents and license before installing.
